## BUSINESS DESCRIPTION

Virginia's premier electric golf cart dealership serving Chesapeake and the Hampton Roads region.
Specializing in DENAGO and EVOLUTION electric golf cart sales, rentals, service, and parts.
Expert automotive professionals with comprehensive knowledge of electric vehicle technology,
golf cart regulations, Virginia state requirements, and local municipal ordinances.
Family-owned business committed to sustainable transportation solutions for Virginia's coastal communities.

## TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS DATABASE

### BATTERY TECHNOLOGY
- 48V Lithium-Ion: Entry-level models, 40-45 mile range
- 72V Lithium-Ion: Premium models, 50-60 mile range
- Charging times: 4-8 hours depending on configuration
- Battery lifespan: 5-7 years with proper maintenance

### PERFORMANCE METRICS
- Top speeds: 20-25 mph (street legal limit)
- Passenger capacity: 2-8 persons depending on model
- Payload capacity: 500-1,200 lbs
- Ground clearance: 4-8 inches

### STREET LEGAL REQUIREMENTS (Virginia)
- Headlights and taillights
- Turn signals
- Mirrors (side and rear)
- Seat belts for all passengers
- Horn
- Parking brake
- VIN and registration
- Insurance required
